Monster Garrick at Winklespruit | KZN South Coast | 4 MASSIVE Garrick caught | Live bait fishing
entries.description:
Pa and the team headed down to Winklespruit this past week in search of some monster Garrick — and guess what? They found exactly what they were looking for! 

The team managed to land 4 beautiful Garrick, with the biggest weighing an incredible 13kg. We used live Shad as bait and slid them out using braid and line.

It turned out to be an amazing morning of fishing, with plenty of action and some serious fish!

To make it even more special, Pa gave his cameraman Trev the opportunity to fight and land a beautiful Garrick of his own. It was Trev’s first time fighting a fish of this size, and what an experience it was!

Another fantastic day on the water with Pa and the team.

entries.title: Port St Johns 2026 - Fishing for Kob and Grunter - Beautiful views - Awesome food and fishing
entries.description:
After a 5-hour road trip filled with incredible views, we finally made it to the beautiful Port St Johns in the Transkei for an unforgettable fishing adventure!

We hit the water that first night and it didn’t take long before we landed the giant Kob we came for! 🐟🔥

The following day was all about slowing down, relaxing with the locals, enjoying some amazing food and having a proper braai while taking in the stunning surroundings.

Pa also shared an important message about why we need to stop illegally jigging fish and protect our fisheries for future generations.
From the epic fishing action and beautiful scenery to the incredible drone footage, this trip had it all. Come along for the adventure and experience the beauty of Port St Johns with us! 🎣❤️

entries.title: Fishing Amanzimtoti | How to catch a Garrick Tutorial and More  !
entries.description:
Join me on another exciting fishing adventure as I head out to the famous Chain Rocks in Amanzimtoti, KwaZulu-Natal. Known for its rugged coastline, crystal-clear waters, and productive fishing spots, Chain Rocks never disappoints!

In this fishing vlog, I target and catch some amazing rock fish while enjoying the stunning ocean views and the thrill of fishing from the rocks. Whether you're an experienced angler or just love watching fishing adventures, this video captures the excitement, challenges, and beauty of fishing along South Africa's coastline.

If you enjoy fishing content, kayak fishing, shore angling, and exploring new fishing spots around Durban and KZN, be sure to like, subscribe, and hit the notification bell so you don't miss future adventures on KayzAdventures!

📍 Location: Chain Rocks, Amanzimtoti, KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa
